title: Credo (Guerrero, Missa Super flumina Babylonis)
desc: Francisco Guerrero, Missa Super flumina Babylonis, Credo, before 1566. 5 voices (Superius, Altus 1, Altus 2, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0026_3); edited by María Elena Cuenca Rodríguez, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
